prompt:
Design brief — your own take on this character. A full-body vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) character card image of Lady Wu from the Romance of the Three Kingdoms, reimagined as an adult woman — Sun Quan's mother, who chose Liu Bei as her son-in-law at Ganlu Temple. Age: late twenties — a graceful grown-up face with soft, smooth contours; no wrinkles, folds or under-eye bags. She is a woman — no beard, moustache or facial hair.

Style (fixed): Korean MMORPG character artwork. A recognisably drawn face with gently simplified anatomical structure. 2D painting with visible brushwork: layered strokes of colour, soft broken edges, thin coloured linework and a few crisp accents on the face and costume.

Inspiration only: dignified matriarch, rich court robes, warm authority.

World (fixed): a river-and-sea kingdom of medieval high fantasy: a vast river delta, crimson-sailed galleons and war galleys, harbor fortresses of red stone, fire magic dancing over dark water. Her costume, weapon and setting belong to this world.

Weapon (fixed — ours): a jade ruyi scepter, reimagined as a Western high-fantasy version of the same kind of object with the same silhouette: polished steel and silvered mithril throughout, the shaft or hilt also forged metal with engraved runes (never plain wood), a faint magical glow running along the edge and the runes, a gem-set guard or socket, a leather-wrapped grip and heraldic or elven ornament, with any animal motif re-sculpted in Western heraldic style and no Chinese fittings, silk tassels or hanzi.

Hair colour (fixed — ours): antique-gold hair. Keep exactly this hair colour; only the hairstyle is yours.

Skin tone (fixed — ours): fair skin. Keep exactly this skin tone.

Costume colours (ours): crimson red, gold, river teal, black lacquer.

Rank (fixed): she is a high court official — her costume must read dignified office at first glance: refined, layered and finely ornamented, with flagship-card detail, never plain or sparse.

Exposure (fixed): bold — her outfit shows skin by design (a deep neckline, bare shoulders or arms, a high slit or short hem); intimate areas covered.

Face proportions: a short midface and a soft, gently rounded jawline with a small soft chin — never a long face or a long, pointed or heavy jaw; any crown or headpiece sits above her hairline and never lengthens her face. Her eyes stay at a natural open size — never squeezed into narrow slits.

Composition: vertical 2:3 full-body framing with modest headroom and clear space below the boots — the whole figure from the top of her crown or headpiece to both boots stays inside the frame, occupying about four-fifths of the image height, with the same camera distance in every genre; her hands and her signature item stay inside the frame. Camera at chest height with natural portrait perspective — no wide-angle distortion, no low angle, no close crop.

RESOLVED ORIGINAL DESIGN
Face: soft heart-shaped face, clear open violet eyes, curved fine brows, petite rounded nose, rose lips, gently assured expression. Antique-gold hair in a shoulder-length cascade of thick curls, small western gold circlet. Costume shape 3: fitted breastplate and pauldrons over a gown skirt flaring to the floor, crimson, gold, river teal and black lacquer. Two nested arch-shaped breastplate edges and hinged skirt panels evoke a welcoming sanctuary portal, built into the armor, no Chinese elements. Deep neckline, bare upper arms, high side opening; intimate areas covered. She stands squarely on a harbor-fortress balcony, left hand resting on a stone balustrade and right hand holding her mithril rune-engraved ruyi-shaped scepter with a teal gem socket, both hands visible. Western red-stone harbor, distant crimson-sailed galleons in clear daylight, no other people.

One woman only, both human hands visible, five fingers per hand, no text, no watermark.
